headline: Google positions new AI glasses as more private than Meta's
summary: Google is positioning its new smart glasses as more privacy-focused than Meta's, aiming to distinguish itself after Meta's glasses earned a negative reputation, nicknamed "pervert glasses." One reviewer says Google's glasses give Meta real competition in the smart-glasses market.
